item.title: Sheet to form: sectioning, folding, joinery
item.description: Getting 3D from 2D sheets: stacked sections, waffle/egg-crate, slotted assemblies, press-fit, living hinges, scoring and folding.

learningObjectives.item: Build a press-fit connection with a measured tolerance
Choose a joinery strategy for a given material

item.content:
Getting 3D from 2D sheets: stacked sections, waffle/egg-crate, slotted assemblies, press-fit, living hinges, scoring and folding.

Ideas

Sectioning, contouring, folding, tessellating (Iwamoto); tolerance and fit; friction fit vs. adhesives; material thickness as a design parameter; the parametric slot.

In class

  • Lecture (30 min)
  • tolerance test kit demo (20 min)
  • press-fit exercise work session (90 min)
